claim: Under an explicit prepared-local-context input policy fixed independently of the requested word and desired answer, the 171 source-completed contexts over L_3 admit an actual native P-family derivation and native E-selection derivation at every supplied region index, retaining every input premise.

source_policy.name: prepared-local-context input policy
source_policy.geometry: For every p in complete L_3, translate the canonical marked regular primitive by the exact four-coordinate inverse of p, complete its P reference using the existing source API, create its five-slot identity packet at origin zero and validate the available PN interface.
source_policy.input_atoms: Only the quoted complete contexts in this validated input family, each paired with its supplied color; not arbitrary atoms or selected-answer records.
source_policy.formal_admission: Admit q = Sigma i:RegionIndex. q equals the literal native package for input row i. NativeTableResolution.Full seed certificates are those explicit pairs, not inferred from atom formation.
source_policy.policy_change: This is a declared prepared-input policy, not the old single canonical seed's path closure. Its Agda seed policy quotes externally validated sector data; Agda does not prove the JavaScript geometry implementation or physical admissibility of this input policy.

native_binding: NativeTableRules P-kind and E-kind with actual NativeTableResolution.Full Resolve applications. Both rules require every region-indexed input premise, even for selection at one supplied index.
formal_data: A generated 171-constructor region-index type and exact JSON strings for complete validated local context records. The color function is an arbitrary supplied formal parameter, not a selected output.
hostiles: replace all native P-rule premises by one seed in a negative Agda module
misclassify the indexed family as a simultaneous occupied assembly
acceptance: Fresh source generation/independent coordinate checks and safe Cubical compilation of actual P/E derivations, with a rejected wrong-premise module. Every literal context appears in the generated native input declaration. No source recovery theorem is being reproved.
boundary: Bounded family admission under the declared input policy. Native derivation of an index from a word, field transport/sewing into a single physical assembly, uniform all-region admission and Ramsey forcing remain unproved.
